verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs show it ingests OpenTelemetry traces and logs via OTLP, offers a trace explorer for spans, and has dashboards that navigate error and performance data. That covers traces and logs in one platform, but metrics and cross-signal pivoting are not documented. Missing for 10: explicit metrics collection, documented pivoting between logs, traces and metrics with shared context (e.g., trace-ID correlation), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can collect metrics, logs, and traces in one platform and pivot between them with shared context

citations.quote: Sentry can ingest OpenTelemetry traces and logs via OTLP endpoints, either directly from an OTel SDK or through a pipeline tool like the OpenTelemetry Collector.
You can now explore span samples, visualize span attributes, and aggregate your data with flexible queries and filters.
allowing you to navigate through error and performance data across multiple projects
Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
